name: SARTrailingSystem
summary: This EA implements a Parabolic SAR-style trailing stop system that manages open positions by dynamically adjusting the stop-loss based on an acceleration factor mechanism. It opens random trades (buy or sell with equal probability) on a timer interval, then trails the stop-loss using SAR logic with configurable acceleration step and cap. The strategy has no directional bias for entries and relies entirely on the SAR trailing mechanism for exits.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了基于抛物线SAR风格的追踪止损系统，通过加速因子机制动态调整持仓的止损位。它在定时器触发时随机开仓（买卖各50%概率），然后使用SAR逻辑配置加速步长和上限来追踪止损。该策略入场无方向性偏好，完全依赖SAR追踪机制出场。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于抛物线SAR指标原理，使用加速因子(AF)和极值点(EP)来动态追踪止损。入场条件极为简单：当RandomTrade开启且TimerFlag为true时，以50%概率随机选择买入或卖出，初始止损设为固定点数(StopLoss参数)。出场条件完全依赖SAR追踪止损：对于多头，当价格创新高时提高EP并增加AF，计算delta=AF*(EP-当前SL)来上移止损；对于空头反之亦然。仓位管理方面，固定1手交易量，无任何仓位调整逻辑。资金管理仅包含简单的保证金检查(CheckMargin函数)，确保可用保证金充足后才下单。策略缺乏真正的入场信号逻辑，随机入场意味着没有任何市场分析，完全依赖SAR追踪来捕获趋势利润，这在震荡市中会造成频繁止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Parabolic SAR indicator principle, using an acceleration factor (AF) and extreme point (EP) to dynamically trail the stop-loss. Entry conditions are extremely simple: when RandomTrade is enabled and TimerFlag is true, the EA randomly selects buy or sell with 50% probability, with an initial stop-loss set at a fixed point distance (StopLoss parameter). Exit conditions rely entirely on SAR trailing: for long positions, when price makes a new high, EP is raised and AF increases, calculating delta=AF*(EP-current SL) to move the stop-loss up; for short positions the reverse applies. Position sizing uses a fixed 1 lot volume with no adjustment logic whatsoever. Money management includes only a basic margin check (CheckMargin function) to ensure sufficient free margin before placing orders. The strategy lacks genuine entry signal logic—random entry means no market analysis at all, relying completely on SAR trailing to capture trend profits, which will cause frequent stop-outs in ranging markets.

parameters.name: TimerTime
parameters.description: 定时器频率（秒），控制随机交易的触发间隔
parameters.description_en: Timer interval in seconds for random trade triggers

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 初始止损距离（点数），开仓时设置的固定止损
parameters.description_en: Initial stop loss distance in points

parameters.name: AFStep
parameters.description: SAR加速因子增量步长，每次创新高/低时AF增加的值

parameters.name: AFCap
parameters.description: SAR加速因子最大值，限制AF的上限防止止损跟随过紧

parameters.name: RandomTrade
parameters.description: 随机交易开关，开启后定时器触发时随机开仓
parameters.description_en: Enable random trade on timer trigger

pros: SAR追踪止损机制成熟，能在大趋势中有效锁定利润，随着趋势发展自动收紧止损
参数可配置性好，AFStep和AFCap允许用户根据不同品种和市场波动率调整追踪灵敏度
包含基本的保证金检查，避免在资金不足时下单导致错误
使用新K线检测逻辑(BarTime)避免在同一根K线上重复修改止损，减少交易频率
pros_en: The SAR trailing stop mechanism is well-established and effectively locks in profits during strong trends, automatically tightening the stop as the trend progresses
Good parameter configurability with AFStep and AFCap allowing users to adjust trailing sensitivity based on different instruments and market volatility
Includes basic margin checking to avoid placing orders when funds are insufficient
Uses new bar detection logic (BarTime) to prevent repeated SL modifications on the same bar, reducing trade frequency
cons: 入场逻辑完全随机，没有任何技术分析或市场判断，相当于赌博式开仓，长期胜率无保证
固定1手交易量，无视账户规模和波动率，缺乏动态仓位管理，大资金下风险不可控
止损修改缺少StopLevel最小距离检查，可能因距离当前价格太近而被服务器拒绝
没有止盈机制，盈利完全依赖追踪止损，在快速反转中可能回吐大量利润
没有考虑点差和滑点，在点差较大的品种上随机入场成本高昂
cons_en: Entry logic is completely random with no technical analysis or market judgment—essentially gambling-style entries with no long-term win rate guarantee
Fixed 1 lot position size ignores account size and volatility, lacking dynamic position sizing—risk is uncontrollable with larger accounts
SL modification lacks StopLevel minimum distance checking, potentially being rejected by the server if too close to current price
No take-profit mechanism—profits depend entirely on trailing stops, which may give back significant profits during rapid reversals
Does not consider spread and slippage—random entry on high-spread instruments incurs significant costs
improvements: 添加基于技术指标的入场信号（如MA交叉、趋势过滤器）替代随机入场，提高策略的逻辑性和胜率
实现动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和ATR波动率计算合理手数，同时添加StopLevel距离检查确保止损修改有效
添加止盈逻辑或时间过滤（避开重要新闻时段和低流动性时段），减少不利条件下的交易
improvements_en: Add technical indicator-based entry signals (e.g., MA crossover, trend filter) to replace random entries, improving strategy logic and win rate
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account balance and ATR volatility, and add StopLevel distance checking to ensure SL modifications are valid
Add take-profit logic or time filters (avoiding major news events and low liquidity sessions) to reduce trading under unfavorable conditions

risk_points: 随机入场无任何方向性优势，在震荡市中SAR追踪会频繁触发止损导致持续亏损
固定1手仓位不考虑账户规模，小账户可能因单笔亏损过大而爆仓
缺少止损修改的最小距离检查(StopLevel)，可能导致订单被拒绝后止损未能及时移动
risk_points_en: Random entry provides no directional edge—SAR trailing will trigger frequent stop-outs in ranging markets leading to continuous losses
Fixed 1 lot position ignores account size—small accounts may face account blow-up from excessive single-trade risk
Missing minimum distance check (StopLevel) for SL modifications may cause order rejections, leaving stops unadjusted
